fields.implementation_summary: Updated test-api execution pruning to scope retention per validation_spec_id instead of globally by run_id. In memory-api/crates/test-api/src/store.rs, prune_execution_runs now computes stale run buckets per (validation_spec_id, run_id), preserving each spec's newest two runs independently. Added regression coverage in memory-api/crates/test-api/src/store/tests.rs: record_execution_prunes_runs_per_spec_not_globally verifies three distinct specs with distinct run_ids all survive while existing single-spec keep-2 behavior remains unchanged.
